fields.name: cfRootPath
fields.label: Content Fragment Root Path
fields.description: Select the hotel experience folder containing the existing Filters Grid Content Fragments. Cards, schedules, pricing, push-to-top settings, and popup details are managed in those fragments, not copied into this block.

fields.name: dateFilterPlaceholder
fields.label: Date Range Filter Placeholder
fields.description: Label shown before the visitor selects an inclusive event date range. Dates are evaluated using each experience's schedule time zone. By-arrangement experiences remain eligible within their availability period.

fields.name: allExperiencesLabel
fields.label: All Experiences Tab Label
fields.description: Label for the tab showing all experiences within the selected date range. No category tag is needed for this tab.

fields.name: categorySettings
fields.label: Category Tabs
fields.description: Add categories in display order. Select tags matching Associated Filter Tags on the experience Content Fragments. Filter first, then place push-to-top matches first. Within each group, sort by earliest matching date, earliest time, and title A-Z; undated by-arrangement items follow scheduled items.

fields.name: categoryTag
fields.label: Category Tag
fields.description: Select one tag under Capella Hotels matching Associated Filter Tags on the experience Content Fragments. Complete before publishing.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Category Tab Label
fields.description: Visitor-facing label for this category, translated for the page language.

fields.name: initialDisplayCount
fields.label: Initial Display Count
fields.description: Positive whole number of experiences initially displayed. Default: 8. Reveal More will append exactly 4 cards per click and hide when no matches remain; the increment is not author-configurable.
